english.title: Cause use of motor vehicle / trailer - equipment in a condition likely to cause danger of injury
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), caused **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), to use on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), a

(A)_[motor vehicle, motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_
(B)_[trailer drawn by a motor vehicle, motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_

the condition of its accessories or equipment, namely **(..SPECIFY CONDITION..), was such that its use involved a danger of injury to any person
english.legislation: Contrary to section 40A of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
caused use on a road of a motor vehicle/trailer
condition of vehicle accessories/equipment was such that involved danger of injury

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) This is an endorsable offence which requires proof that there was a danger of injury. For the less serious offences view H206, H207, H238, H239, H240 and H243.
(ii) See also offence wordings: H3100, H3101, H3102, H3104, H3105, H3106, H3107 and H3108.
(iii) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
english.standardstatementoffacts:
At **(..SPECIFY TIME..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant caused **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) to use

(A)_[a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_
(B)_[a trailer drawn by a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_

on **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..). Its use involved danger of injury to a person because **(..SPECIFY CONDITION GIVING RISE TO THE DANGER..).

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale if in respect of goods vehicle or vehicle adapted to carry more than eight passengers.

A fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale in any other case.

Obligatory endorsement - licence endorsed three penalty points.

Discretionary disqualification.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

dvlacode.description: (Causing or Permitting) Causing or likely to cause danger by reason of use of unsuitable vehicle or using a vehicle with parts or accessories (excluding brakes, steering or tyres) in a dangerous condition

libra.complexpenaltydetails:
